sys_script.message:
(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {

    restrictTrades();

    function restrictTrades() {
        var user = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        user.get(gs.getUserID());
        var market = user.u_associated_business_markets;
        if (market != '' && market != undefined) {
            var trdquery = "owning_businessIN" + market + "^ORother_businessIN" + market + "^ORowning_business=^ORother_business=";
        }
        current.addEncodedQuery(trdquery);
    }


})(current, previous);
sys_script.name: MSS Custody Passive Task Query
